integrity: The proof and exact-rate recurrence are self-contained. Finite labeled-state tests, exact coefficient tests, and numerical quadrature support but do not replace the infinite-limit proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive ratio of per-triple to per-pair attempt rates; complete two-/three-uniform hypergraph, irreversible deposition, terminal vacancy count only. Results are not claims about one-dimensional lattices, Euclidean RSA, or uniform joint rate-size limits. Historical-priority comparisons do not amount to exhaustive certification.
title: Exact residual-vacancy law for competing dimers and trimers on a complete substrate
